defs.def: to speak to God, especially to give thanks or ask for help 祈祷；祷告

ex.s: Maybe that feeling comes from growing up in South Africa, where the phrase “there are children starving in Africa” was more of an uncomfortable reminder of fact than a prayer at dinner time.
ex.t: 也许那种感觉源于在南非长大，在那里，“非洲有儿童在挨饿”这句话与其说是一句餐前祈祷，不如说是对现实令人不安的提醒。

ex.s: And I should pray for the glory of a colourful sunset.
ex.t: 我应该为绚丽多彩的日落之美祈祷。

ex.s: In the future, I pray that you will do the same.
ex.t: 在未来，我祈祷你们也会这样做。

ex.s: The people began weeping and praying.

defs.def: to hope very much that sth will happen 企盼；祈望

ex.s: They had a look of 3 panic / preparedness in their eyes and many of the younger ones were 4 wearing / weeping.Many of the older people seemed to be 5 pouring / praying.
ex.t: 他们眼中流露着______的神情，许多年轻人在______。许多年长的人似乎在______。
